memory: I keep: C13 requires a 10.000 µm stainless shim bonded to a rigid phenolic washer. Adhesive mounting was discarded (it added ~0.6–0.8 µm compliance). I adopted a three-point kinematic coupling (Kelvin-style). Prototype (12 cycles) gave mean 10.004 µm, stdev 0.18 µm. Correction: finish and burrs are primary error sources. I lapped seats to Ra<0.05 µm and removed burrs; 15-cycle test now mean 10.002 µm, stdev 0.12 µm, range ±0.23 µm. Remaining variability localizes to particulate contamination at contact points. Current position: proceed to controlled-cleanliness 50-cycle test.
openQuestion: Does Ra<0.05 µm finishing plus particle-control reduce mount variability to ±0.20 µm over 50 cycles?
